description.narrative: Improved safety and resilience of land and maritime transport infrastructure

Detailed design and feasibility studies of 40 critical bridges and 3 maritime infrastructure are informed by revised standards with climate resilience and safety considerations (2014 Baseline:0) Progress/Status: A variation was agreed between Beca and the Fiji Roads Authority (FRA) to revise the original scope of works, which initially included full detailed designs for 40 bridges and 3 jetties. The revised scope reduced this to full detailed designs for 20 bridges and 3 jetties, with the remaining 20 bridges to proceed to concept design only. This change was made due to high-cost estimates, and the revised completion date was set for 28 December 2025. ADB provided its No Objection to this variation.
Subsequently, a further reduction in scope was agreed between FRA and Beca. The new arrangement includes full detailed designs for 15 bridges, preliminary designs for 13 bridges, and pre-feasibility studies for 12 bridges. This adjustment was necessary due to delays resulting from a government-led design review, which introduced changes to the design criteria. ADB provided its No Objection to this variation.
